evidence: The report covers PowerToys 0.100.0, installed via PowerToys auto-update, affecting TextExtractor.

Reported reproduction: 1. Open PowerToys Settings. 2. Navigate to Text Extractor. 3. Change the activation shortcut from Win + Shift + T to Win + Shift + Q. 4. Save the shortcut change. 5. Close the Settings window. 6. Press Win + Shift + Q anywhere on the desktop or in an application. 7. Observe that Text Extractor does not launch and no OCR selection overlay appears.
Reported result: Pressing the configured shortcut ( Win + Shift + Q ) does not launch Text Extractor. No screen selection overlay appears, and no text extraction action is performed.

Expected result: When pressing the configured Text Extractor shortcut ( Win + Shift + Q ), Text Extractor should launch and display the screen selection overlay, allowing text to be selected and copied using OCR.
